statement: The UniCredit OpenCart 3 module deliberately supports PHP 7.3.0+ across its practical OC3 compatibility matrix (3.0.3.6, 3.0.3.8, 3.0.3.9). This is the module floor, not a claim that OpenCart 3.0.3.6 itself universally requires PHP 7.3.
rationale: reference-oc3-core 3.0.3.9 system/startup.php and installer require PHP 7.3.0+
First remote test runtime reference is PHP 7.3.33
AES-256-GCM, hash_hkdf, random_bytes, hash_equals, JSON and cURL+TLS are native on 7.3
Do not freeze 7.1 merely because crypto is theoretically available there
forbidden_above_floor: Throwable-only catch assumptions that exclude Exception on older hierarchies
deferred_runtime_verification: Exact PHP version on the first remote test host
